name: mdx-pages-agent-citation-policy
human_line: An agent may cite a page only when the page has earned it: published on the governed rail, source known, a named owner, and a review that is not past due.
trusted_for_ai_rule: published AND source_known AND named owner AND NOT stale

enforcement.live_model_calls: no page content rides into live provider calls today - the system context is prompt packs, persona layers, and this session's own recorded history; when page grounding turns on, every candidate must come from the citable list route
enforcement.charter_corpus: charter-backed pages are citable by declaration - their evidence is counted in the lifecycle projection
enforcement.search_surface: search marks every hit citable or not from the same flag - one rule, every surface
enforcement.structural_pin: check-pages-agent-citation fails the build if the live gateway or stream path reaches for page bodies directly

declared_not_built.semantic_retrieval: arrives with CTX - retrieved candidates will still be filtered by this policy, never around it
declared_not_built.strategy_page_proposals: Strategy and Product proposing pages from ratification packets awaits its own governed write contract
declared_not_built.forge_auto_publish: Forge writes draft build handoffs onto the same review rail as every human - auto-publish is not a thing
